title: Explore Spike Unit Result
description: Return of the explore-spike-unit agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, and the finding for the unit with the commit subject and the files it changed

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question a human should settle, or an empty string

summary.description: Summary of the findings for this unit

file.description: Path to a file containing relevant code

recommendation.description: Recommendation based on the findings, or an empty string

commit_subject.description: Subject line for the commit of the exploratory code

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of every file the exploration created or changed
